description: This Java class provides utility methods for testing security-related functionalities, specifically related to a test user, within the book project. It includes methods to retrieve a predefined test user and to insert a test user into a repository.

classes.name: SecurityTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling a test user in security-related test cases, including retrieval and insertion into a repository.

methods.name: getTestUser
methods.description: Retrieves a test user with a fixed email from the provided UserRepository; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: insertTestUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new test user with predefined email and password into the UserRepository.
